resources.name: aug-cc-pVQZ basis set for elements H, B, C, N, O, F, Na, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ga, Ge, As, Se, Br, Kr

access.notes: Standard augmented correlation consistent polarized valence quadruple-zeta basis set available from the Basis Set Exchange or via quantum chemistry packages.

resources.name: aug-cc-pV5Z basis set for elements H, B, C, N, O, F, Na, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ga, Ge, As, Se, Br, Kr

access.notes: Standard augmented correlation consistent polarized valence quintuple-zeta basis set. For Na, if aug-cc-pV5Z is not available, use the uncontracted basis from the original Peterson/Dunning reference.

The list of molecules comprising the 19 atomization energies, 15 ionization energies, 4 electron affinities, and 2 proton affinities is defined in the paper text and in standard G2 compilations (e.g., Curtiss et al., J. Chem. Phys. 103, 6104 (1995)). Molecular structures are well-known and must be constructed by the agent.

Any package capable of CCSD(T) and B3LYP calculations with correlation consistent basis sets (e.g., ORCA: https://orcaforum.kofo.mpg.de; Psi4: https://psicode.org; NWChem: https://nwchemgit.github.io).

resources.name: Experimental reference values for G2 third-row test set

access.notes: Compiled from: Moore (Natl. Bur. Stand. Circ. 467), Berkowitz (J. Chem. Phys. 89, 7065), Gibson et al. (J. Chem. Phys. 85, 4815), Gurvich (Thermodynamic Properties of Individual Substances), Lias (J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data Suppl. 17, 1), and other sources. The agent must obtain these from the cited literature.

resources.name: Spin-orbit corrections for third-row atoms and molecules

access.notes: Corrections from Moore tables (Natl. Bur. Stand. Circ. 467) for atomic species and from Blaudeau & Curtiss, Int. J. Quantum Chem. 61, 943 (1997) for molecular species. Agent must use the values reported therein.
